A leaf, a rock and a candle flame. That was his daily habit as a kid.

Kevin Trudeau says wealthy people would go into nature, pick up a leaf and just look at it. When he was young he did the same by the brook near his house.

He says the leaf would almost dissolve into nothingness, and he did it every day. He wasn't trying to name it, and later he realized it was meditation.

What simple habit from childhood have you lost?
